sources.title: ISO 2859-1:1999. Sampling procedures for inspection by attributes, Part 1

concepts.definition: Identifying, evaluating and selecting suppliers and agreeing terms with them.
ICC trade terms that define who pays for and bears the risk of transport, insurance and customs.
A sampling inspection that accepts or rejects a batch based on defects found in a statistical sample.
The approved reference sample that production must match.

questions.q: Who bears transport risk under EXW, FOB and DDP?
questions.a: EXW: the buyer from the factory door; FOB: the buyer once goods are on board at the port; DDP: the seller up to delivery with duties paid.

questions.q: Why write a product specification before asking for quotes?
questions.a: Without it quotes are not comparable and samples cannot be judged.

questions.q: Name six criteria for evaluating a supplier.
questions.a: Legitimacy, capability, quality, compliance, communication and terms.
